nse_results_data.re_desc_note_fin: The consolidated financial results comprise the financial results of the Co and its subsidiaries herein after referred to as the Group and its joint ventures The above unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results of the Company and the Group have been prepared in accordance with the IndAS as notified by MCA pursuant to Section 133 of the Co Act read with Rule and in terms of regulation 33 of the SEBI LODR Regulations and other accounting principles generally accepted in India      The Groups primary business segment is reflected based on the principal business activities carried on by the entities in the Group in the following operating segments ie Consumer durables Electronics manufacturing services and Railway subsystem and Mobility       The Board of AT Railway at their meeting on 23 Mar 2024 approved the formation of a JV alliance with Yujin Machinery Ltd Joint Venture Partner based in South Korea Sinkodia Pte Ltd Financial Partner based in Singapore and Dujin International Financial Partner based in South Korea A definitive agreement was signed on 5 April 2024 for the investment and establishment of a JVC dedicated to the manufacturing of all types of wagons trams trains metros and related ancillary products      During the current quarter the JVC Yujin Machinery India Pvt Ltd was incorporated on 20 Aug 2024 As of 30 Sep 2024 no investments have been made      The Reconstruction Committee of the Board in their meeting on 7 Sep 2024 approved the acquisition of AmberPR business through a slump sale on a going concern basis for a lump sum purchase consideration A business transfer agreement was entered on 30 Sep 2024 with an effective date for the transfer set for 1 Oct 2024      Subsequent to the quarter ended 30 Sep 2024 the JV Committee of the Board of the IL JIN at their meeting held on 15 Oct 2024 approved formation of a JV alliance with KCC to carry on the business of manufacturing of HDI Flex Semiconductor Substrates PCBs and the JV agreement has been executed on 15 Oct 2024

The above unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results of the Co have been prepared in accordance with the IndAS as notified by MCA pursuant to Sec 133 of Co Act read with Rule and as per regulation 33 of the SEBI LODR Regulations        The consolidated financial results comprise the financial results of the Co and its subsidiaries      The Board of ILJIN at its meeting held on 16 Sep 2023 approved an arrangement for entering into a JV with Nexxbase JV agreement was entered into on 18 Sep 2023 and the underlying JVC namely Stelltek Technologies Pvt Ltd has been incorporated on 26 Dec 2023 IL JIN shall own 50% of shareholding in the JVC The JVC will carry on the business of manufacturing assembling and designing of wearables and other smart electronics products      The Board of IL JIN at its meeting held on 21 Oct 2023 has given an inprincipal approval for investment in Ascent ILJIN has entered into definitive agreements on 2 Jan 2024 for acquiring 60% equity shares in Ascent and pursuant to the said agreement ILJIN has paid full consideration on 2 Feb 2024 Pursuant to the said acquisition Ascent has become subsidiary of IL JIN and stepdown subsidiary of Co      The Board of  Sidwal at its meeting held on 20 Oct 2023 approved formation of a joint venture alliance with Titagarh and its promoters for undertaking investment in Shivaliks Mercantile Pvt Ltd an existing company which will become a JVSPV to carry on the business of railway components and sub systems for the rolling stock industry in India and overseas and also expand their business into the global markets and are desirous of undertaking investment in Titagarh Firema SpA Italy which is inter alia in the similar business Both Titagarh and Sidwal will invest up to Rs12000 lakhs each in the JVSPV in one or more tranches Subsequent to the period ended 31 Dec 2023 Sidwal has entered into definitive agreements dated 24 Jan 2024 for acquiring equal control in Shivaliks      Subsequent to the period ended 31 Dec2023 the Holding Company has on 31 Jan 2024 acquired 3100, 9% OFCD of Rs10 lakhs each for aggregating to amounting Rs 31000 lakhs of IL JIN       The Board of IL JIN at its meeting held on 10 Feb 2024 and Ever at its meeting held on 8 Feb 2024 has approved the scheme of amalgamation among IL JIN and Ever The Board of the Co also in its meeting dated 10 Feb 2024 approved the above scheme The scheme is yet to be filed with NCLT for required approvals. The effect of the scheme is considered in these financial results

The above unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results of the Company and the Group have been prepared in accordance with the Ind AS as notified by MCA pursuant to Section 133 of the Cos Act 2013 read with rule 3 and in terms of regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Regulations and other accounting principles generally accepted in India       The consolidated financial results comprise the financial results of the Company and its subsidiaries      The above unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended on 30 June 2023 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee of the Company and taken on record by the Board of Directors in their respective meetings held on 25 July 2023 The Statutory Auditors have conducted Limited Review of these results in terms of Regulation 33 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015 as amended and have expressed an unmodified report on the above results      The certificate obtained from the Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial officer in respect of above results in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015 has been placed before the Board of Directors      The Companys and Groups primary business segment is reflected based on the principal business activities carried on by the Company and the Group The Company and Group operates in one reportable business segment ie. manufacturing of consumer durable products and is primarily operating in India and hence considered as single geographical segment Accordingly there are no separate reportable business segments as per Ind AS 108 Operating Segments
